name: Any-API MCP Server
description: A configurable MCP server that adapts any HTTP API into an MCP toolset with generic HTTP tools (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and pluggable authentication. Includes API discovery scripts and supports dynamic tool generation from OpenAPI specs or wordlist scans.

rawRecord.description: A configurable MCP server that adapts any HTTP API into an MCP toolset with generic HTTP tools (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and pluggable authentication. Includes API discovery scripts and supports dynamic tool generation from OpenAPI specs or wordlist scans.

API_BASE.description: The base URL of the API

AUTH_MODE.description: Authentication mode: none, bearer, header, basic, or query

AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token or header value depending on auth mode

AUTH_QUERY_KEY.description: Query parameter key used if AUTH_MODE=query

ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE.description: Guard writes - set to true to allow POST/PUT/DELETE operations
